Layout.metaTitle: Camino-Hub — the official Camino de Santiago routes
Layout.metaDescription: Browse, filter and compare the official Camino de Santiago routes: distance, days, difficulty and full stage lists.
Layout.footerLine1: Camino-Hub lists the officially recognised routes of the Camino de Santiago.
Layout.footerLine2: Distances and stage divisions follow common guidebook conventions and are approximate. Always carry a current guide and check conditions locally before setting out.

NotFound.title: We could not find that route
NotFound.lede: The page you asked for does not exist. The fifteen official routes are all listed in the catalog.

Catalog.title: Every official Camino de Santiago
Catalog.lede: Fifteen recognised routes, from a five-day walk out of Ferrol to a seven-hundred-kilometre crossing from Seville. Filter by what you actually have — distance, time, and how hard you want it to be.
Catalog.emptyLede: Try allowing more distance or more days, or clear the filters to see all fifteen.

RouteDetail.stagesIntro: The conventional stage division. Distances over 30 km are highlighted — those are the days worth planning around.

Compare.metaDescription: Put the official Camino routes side by side.
Compare.title: Compare routes
Compare.emptyLede: Nothing selected yet. Tick Compare on two or more routes in the catalog and they will line up here.
Compare.onlyOneLede: Only one route selected — go back and tick another to see a real comparison.

CompareBar.hintPickMore: Pick at least one more to compare.

EASY.label: Easy
EASY.blurb: Gentle terrain and short stages, with services throughout.

MODERATE.label: Moderate
MODERATE.blurb: Sustained walking with real climbs, but nothing technical.

HARD.label: Hard
HARD.blurb: Long days, big ascent or long gaps between services.

Auth.loginLede: Sign in to save routes you want to walk and mark the ones you've finished.
Auth.registerLede: One account to track the routes you're planning and the ones you've walked.
